$comment: Terms Herald's code must not use (ADR 0002, ADR 0003; harness-engineering D-3). Checked by scripts/rules.mjs. Each exception names a file, the term and why it stays.

terms.name: tenant
terms.message: The organising entity is an organisation, never a tenant (ADR 0003). The identity directory's tenant is an external name: add an exception with its reason.

terms.name: game names
terms.message: No game names in code (ADR 0002): a game's rules enter as a policy, its data through an adapter.

terms.name: Wizards of the Coast
terms.pattern: Wizards of the Coast|\bMTG\b|Magic: The Gathering|\bGatherer\b
terms.message: No Wizards of the Coast content in the repository's code.

terms.name: sibling projects
terms.message: Herald's code does not name its sibling projects, except where it shares something with them: add an exception with its reason.
